records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite onboarding call [calendar:989eaaba] and two nudges [email:0e32baa6, email:5d3191c8]. Only customer reply was a non-committal "Will do, thanks" [email:3c39bcf7] with no follow-through since. Team plan and an attended call suggest real intent, so some unaided chance in the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick reply last week -- glad the getting-started call was useful.

Whenever you're ready, the natural first step is a first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. From there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather bring the whole Granite Partners team in at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
